video_title: Has Dylan Harper earned the starting job over De’Aaron Fox? 👀 + Spurs offseason outlook | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama acknowledges his need for development and improvement
quotes.excerpt: He recognizes that he is not a complete player
quotes.quote: He took a lot of ownership and responsibility that he needed to improve. There were answers that he gave in French that when you saw the translation, really echoed that and got more into it where he said about how much he has to focus on developing his game. He recognizes that he is not a complete player.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's immaturity and trash talk need to be cleaned up
quotes.excerpt: He could clean up some of the trash talks as borderline arrogant things that he says sometimes
quotes.quote: He could clean up some of the trash talks as borderline arrogant things that he says sometimes. On the court, he had some immature moments. That flagrant foul that he had against Naz Reid almost cost him dearly in these finals.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama is expected to sign a rookie max extension
quotes.excerpt: Victor Wembanyama, who will likely sign a $250 million rookie max extension this offseason
quotes.quote: All five starters are under contract, including Victor Wembanyama, who will likely sign a $250 million rookie max extension this offseason.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs need a stretch big to complement Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: They need a combo big that can kind of complement Victor here when you look at a stretch four
quotes.quote: They need a combo big that can kind of complement Victor here when you look at a stretch four, maybe a player like Rui Hachimura from the Los Angeles Lakers here. You pair him up, he gives you a big that can shoot the ball.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's starting role is not as important as finishing games
quotes.excerpt: It doesn't matter who starts, it matters who finishes
quotes.quote: I don't see a guy like Dylan Harper saying, oh I need to start right away right now. He might want to, but you have that three-headed monster. That's a good problem to have. You have Manu Ginobili there who can mentor Dylan Harper and say, it doesn't matter who starts, it matters who finishes. As long as you're getting the minutes, I'm sure they're going to give him the contract that he wants.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs should look for another big man this summer
quotes.excerpt: I think they should go out and try to look for another big man
quotes.quote: For me, I think they should go out and try to look for another big man. Zach Collins is great, I love him, but certain matchups they felt they couldn't play him on the floor. I'm looking at a guy like Robert Williams from the Portland Trail Blazers who could be a target they should be looking at this summer.
